title: With nothing ticked Deactivate is disabled and its hover text says why
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOTICK-01) is active at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Hover over the Deactivate button on the bar.
  6. Click the Deactivate button.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row.
  8. Hover over the Deactivate button.
  9. Click the {Part-A} row again.
  10. Hover over the Deactivate button.
  11. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The Deactivate button is visible but dimmed (disabled), and hovering it shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".
  • Step 6: Nothing opens: no "Deactivate parts?" confirmation appears.
  • Step 8: With 1 row ticked the button is bright blue (enabled) and the hover text does not appear.
  • Step 10: With nothing ticked again, the button is disabled and hovering shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".
  • Step 11: Bulk mode ends and {Part-A} is still active.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R8, S2-N1, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.2 (Mode on), board 4.3 (Two rows ticked), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R8: “The Deactivate button is disabled while no row is ticked. Hovering it then shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".”
  • S2-N1: “With nothing ticked, the Deactivate button is visible but disabled, so the confirmation cannot open.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Deactivate hovered with nothing ticked): “"Tick the parts to deactivate" | Tooltip on the disabled button”
